purpose: Independent feasibility review of incremental hotel demand after joining Airbnb; NYC focus

sources.title: Cloudbeds / Duetto Hotel Market Pulse, Fall 2025
sources.limitations: Provider-reported actual operational data. Full report population includes boutique hotels, B&Bs, vacation rentals and small chains. Airbnb-connected sample count, same-property construction, NYC coverage, onboarding dates, and HotelTonight treatment are not specified. Precedes May 2026 expansion.

sources.title: Cloudbeds Channel Production Report
sources.access: Public documentation read; customer report not accessed
sources.claim: Report filters by service date, room type, source/subchannel and exports Excel/PDF with room nights, revenue and ADR. Property owner access is required. Room revenue includes no-show fees and manual adjustments but excludes taxes and cancellation fees.

sources.title: Cloudbeds reporting catalogue
sources.claim: Available reporting includes channel performance with rooms, nights, revenue and commissions and source-filtered occupancy; features vary by account.

sources.title: Mews: Confirming the connectivity partner on your channel extranet
sources.access: Full primary article text returned by search index; direct open returned JavaScript shell
sources.period: Current as retrieved 2026-09-07; revision date not identified
sources.claim: Mews Channel Manager is powered by SiteMinder. Its Airbnb connection runs through HotelTonight and needs an active HotelTonight contract/account. Airbnb account manager sets HotelTonight as connectivity provider.
sources.limitation: Does not establish how every PMS or a specific provider's research report labels consumer-origin bookings.

sources.title: Cloudbeds supported distribution channels
sources.claim: Directory separately lists Airbnb API, Airbnb iCal and HotelTonight. iCal syncs availability only.

sources.title: Amadeus Demand360 product specification
sources.access: Public documentation read; commercial data not obtained
sources.claim: Actual forward booking data and channel/segment market benchmarking are available; public page does not promise separate Airbnb storefront identification or unrestricted named-property competitor data.

sources.title: STR Data Assessment methodology
sources.period: 2019 document; current contract-specific methodology requires confirmation
sources.claim: Market calculations account for non-reporting properties; not every market room-night total is directly contributed.

sources.title: Airbnb standards for hotels and professional hospitality businesses
sources.claim: Featured hotels have multiple room types on one property page. Legacy professional property types are broader than hotels alone.

sources.title: AirHost: multiple inventory in one Airbnb listing
sources.claim: One listing can hold multiple rooms of a hotel room type; ten-room example. Listing count is not room count.

sources.title: Airbnb: why calendar nights may be blocked
sources.claim: Blocking can reflect linked calendars, pending reservations, restrictions or account problems, not just booked Airbnb stays.

sources.title: Inside Airbnb data assumptions
sources.claim: Occupancy model assumes 50% review rate plus average stay; no hotel-cohort validation is supplied.

sources.title: NYC Tourism 2025 annual performance
sources.limitation: All-hotel NYC benchmarks, not independent hotels listed on Airbnb.

sources.title: NYC OSE FAQ for building owners
sources.claim: Class B approved transient occupancy differs from ordinary residential entire-unit short stays; tax class is not legal occupancy class.

sources.title: SiteMinder Luna Volcan case study
sources.claim: Several channels, pricing and metasearch strategy changed together; outcomes cannot isolate Airbnb's effect.

overlap_check.scope: Current local research, analysis and processed .md/.csv/.json files, targeted URL and phrase search before writing this note
overlap_check.limitation: Not a full independent audit of unshared material or every archive; Inside Airbnb and NYC macro context are reused.
